pictures.name: LA1-Carpenters-Yard
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A small, poor carpenter’s yard beside a mud-brick house in an old Punjabi town at late afternoon. Bhai Lalo, a thin, kind-faced working man of about forty with a short black beard, a plain off-white turban and a rough cotton kurta, planes a wooden beam, wood shavings curling at his feet. Sitting on a low string cot in the yard, seen only from behind, Guru Nanak, a figure in a long saffron-brown robe and a simple soft turban, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible. Warm gold light, simple and humble.

pictures.name: LA2-Plain-Bread

No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Inside Bhai Lalo’s tiny mud house by the glow of a cooking fire: Lalo, the thin kind-faced man with a short black beard and plain off-white turban, kneels and offers a brass plate of two coarse, rough brown flatbreads with both hands, smiling shyly. At the edge of the frame, only the hands of Guru Nanak in a saffron-brown sleeve reach out gladly to receive it. Warm, humble, loving.

pictures.name: LA5-Two-Breads
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A close, symbolic view: two hands in saffron-brown sleeves held out side by side over a small brass bowl. The left hand gently squeezes a coarse brown flatbread, and pure white drops of milk fall from it into the bowl, glowing. The right hand is closed around a rich, glistening fried pastry, half in deep shadow. Malik Bhago’s jeweled green sleeve and shocked face are blurred in the background. Reverent, quiet, no blood shown.

No text, letters or logos. A small modern car repair workshop at morning, tools on the wall.
